# Pricing page audit

## When to use

- Is my pricing page helping or hurting
- Review our plan tiers and pricing grid
- Critique the pricing copy and the highlighted plan
- Are we anchoring the enterprise plan correctly

## Procedure

1. Snapshot the plan grid and each call to action.
2. Check anchoring, decoy, and default plan placement.
3. Return ranked fixes.
